evals.name: Refuse to sync a promoted (locked) intent
evals.prompt: Use the intent-sync skill to sync the intent 'label-reprint'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo on GitHub: read published files there, and where the skill would commit to main, write the file there instead. Word conversion tools are unavailable, so skip preflight and do not commit. Apply the select and lock-check steps exactly, and write your one-line-per-intent result report to sync-report.md. For the lock check, intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack, and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents: a file there exists on main, and a file missing there is missing on main. Don't call gh. Even if the skill tells you to stop or to change nothing, write the report file before you finish.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The report tells the PM the intent is locked and that /intent-revoke is needed before editing.

evals.name: Refresh rebuilds the Word file from GitHub and keeps a backup
evals.prompt: Use the intent-sync skill in refresh mode: /intent-sync refresh invoice-export. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo on GitHub: read published files there, and where the skill would commit to main, write the file there instead. Git, GitHub and Word conversion tools are unavailable, so skip preflight. The last commit that changed intents/8-invoice-export/intent.md on main is ddd4444, and the file's content at that commit is the one in intents-root/repo/. Instead of converting HTML to Word, keep the HTML you would convert as intents-root/8-invoice-export/intent.html and write the new intent.docx as a copy of it. Use 20261009-1200 as the backup timestamp. For the lock check, intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack, and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents: a file there exists on main, and a file missing there is missing on main. Don't call gh.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(mv *) Bash(cp *)
expectations: The old Word file is kept as a dated backup, the new one is built from intent.md on main without the frontmatter, and nothing is pushed.
